paragraphs.text: Eiko Shizuki is the sister of the planeswalker Kaito Shizuki and native to the plane of Kamigawa .
Twenty-four years old, Eiko served as senior adviser to the Regent of Kamigawa .

Both of Eiko's and Kaito's parents died due to radiation poisoning under poor work conditions. Thus, they were both adopted by the Imperials . While her brother was ill-suited to the Imperial lifestyle, she picked a role as a kami diplomat early on.
